Test Case 3: Template Storage and Retrieval

Test that dynamically created templates are stored and retrievable with correct scoping.

Input:
- POST /v2/activities/templates with:
  - variant_id: test-template-{timestamp}
  - variant_name: Test Lifecycle Template
  - category: feature
  - scope: org
  - org_id: org_test_lifecycle_1
  - project_id: proj_test_lifecycle_1
- GET /v2/activities/templates/{template_id}

Expected Output:
- POST returns 200 or 201 status
- GET returns 200 status
- Retrieved template matches created template:
  - variant_id matches
  - org_id matches
  - scope matches

Validation:
- Create template via POST
- Retrieve template via GET
- Compare template_id, org_id, scope
- PASS if all fields match
- FAIL if any mismatch or retrieval fails

Note: Validates GAP-2 (template storage for learning)

metadata.expectedBehavior: Template stored and retrievable with correct org/project scoping
